items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...a friend of yours and mine -- a young bass player, named Joe Benjamin... [INTERVIEWEE] That's right -- he was his protege.

ctx.x: Yeah, he would know exactly how to orchestrate it. And the only person that ever learned to do that was a bass player, a friend of yours and mine -- a young bass player, named Joe Benjamin, which Tom taught.
That's right -- he was his protege.
